mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies around Reddan Soccer Park under a Full Moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will cool down to an overnight low of 52 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

City officials announced that a portion of Hwy M will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for final paving work, so please follow the posted detours. Additionally, ongoing road improvements are continuing as part of the broader Aldi development project.

We have a busy schedule ahead with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, and keep an eye out for trivia nights starting Tuesday at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus the downtown farmer's market.

In a report covering the first half of September, officers responded to a wide range of calls, including an unusual event on September 5 where they found multiple vehicles with slices of cheese left on their windshields as part of a viral prank.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the classic Turtle. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop in for a treat.
